We introduce the task of automatically revising scientific papers based on peer feedback and release ARIES, a dataset of review comments and their corresponding paper edits.

In experiments with 10 models covering the state of the art, we find that they struggle even to identify which edits correspond to a comment—especially when the relationship between the edit and the comment is indirect and requires reasoning to uncover.
We also extensively analyze GPT-4’s ability to generate edits given a comment and the original paper.
We introduce the task of automatically revising scientific papers based on peer feedback and release ARIES, a dataset of review comments and their corresponding paper edits.
We automatically create a high-precision silver training set, as well as an expert-labeled test set that shows high inter-annotator agreement.
